title: Ontology
description: The flag taxonomy: contains-flags (what a recipe has), compound avoid-flags (user-facing shortcuts that expand transitively), attributes (positive descriptors), diet options. Extending is purely additive — one line here, never a migration.

contains_flags.description: Flags a recipe may contain, derived from its ingredients.

compound_avoid_flags.description: User-facing avoid/require shortcuts. Each expands (transitively) to member contains-flags. Keys double as required-attribute chips.

attributes.description: Positive descriptor vocabularies, grouped by dimension (effort, time_bucket, calorie_bucket, technique).

diet_options.description: Ordered diet options for the variant switcher.
